paper_title: How Knowledge Popularity Influences and Enhances LLM Knowledge Boundary   Perception
caption: The QA performance, confidence, and alignment of Llama3 under different relation popularity.

model_annotations.Bulgarian:
The figure illustrates the relationship between Answer Popularity and three different metrics - Accuracy, Confidence, and Alignment - for Llama3-8B on Movies. 

The X-axis is labeled "Answer Popularity," has a linear scale, and ranges from 0 to 100, with numerical labels at intervals of 20. The Y-axis is labeled "Values," also has a linear scale, and ranges from 0.0 to 1.0, with numerical labels at intervals of 0.2.

The graph contains three distinct lines, each representing one of the metrics. The blue line with circular markers represents Accuracy, the green line with triangular markers represents Confidence, and the red line with square markers represents Alignment. 

The Accuracy line starts at approximately 0.52 when Answer Popularity is 10 and increases steadily to around 0.88 when Answer Popularity is 110, with a slight flattening of the curve as it approaches the higher end of the Answer Popularity range. The Confidence line begins at about 0.84 when Answer Popularity is 10 and rises to nearly 0.95 when Answer Popularity is 50, remaining relatively stable thereafter. The Alignment line commences at roughly 0.75 when Answer Popularity is 10, exhibits a minor fluctuation between 10 and 30, and then ascends to approximately 0.9 when Answer Popularity is 110. 

Overall, the three lines exhibit an upward trend as Answer Popularity increases, although they do so at varying rates and with different starting points.
model_annotations.German: This chart displays the values of accuracy, confidence, and alignment for Llama3-8B on movies in relation to answer popularity. The x-axis, labeled "Answer Popularity," ranges from 0 to 100 in intervals of 20, representing the popularity of the answers. The y-axis, labeled "Values," is scaled from 0.0 to 1.0 in intervals of 0.2, representing the values of the three metrics. The blue line, representing accuracy, starts at approximately 0.53 when the answer popularity is around 5 and increases to about 0.88 as the answer popularity reaches 110, showing a steady rise throughout the range. The green line, denoting confidence, begins at around 0.84 at an answer popularity of 5, increases to a peak of 0.94 at an answer popularity of 50, and then remains stable at 0.94 as the answer popularity continues to 110. The red line, indicating alignment, starts at approximately 0.73 when the answer popularity is 5, experiences a slight dip before rising to around 0.86 at an answer popularity of 40, and continues to climb to about 0.90 as the answer popularity reaches 110.
